dialogues.jp: 学校からの帰り道、ふと桜公園で立ち止まる。
dialogues.en: I walked through the Sakura Park, on the way home.
dialogues.text: I walked through the Sakura Park, on the way home.

dialogues.jp: ん、あれは……。
dialogues.en: Hm, that's...?
dialogues.text: Hm, that's...?

dialogues.jp: 環が桜の木の下で立っている。
dialogues.en: Tamaki... she was standing under a sakura tree.
dialogues.text: Tamaki... she was standing under a sakura tree.

dialogues.jp: 桜の木をじっと見上げ、何か考え込んでいる。
dialogues.en:
She was looking up at the tree, seemingly thinking about
something.
dialogues.text:
She was looking up at the tree, seemingly thinking about
something.

dialogues.en: "Tamaki?"
dialogues.text: "Tamaki?"

dialogues.jp: 環は俺の声に振り返る。
dialogues.en: She turned around at the sound of my voice.
dialogues.text: She turned around at the sound of my voice.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「あら、朝倉様」
dialogues.en: "My, Asakura-sama."
dialogues.text: "My, Asakura-sama."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「何やってるんだ。じっと木なんか見つめて」
dialogues.en: "What're you doing here, staring at a tree like this?"
dialogues.text: "What're you doing here, staring at a tree like this?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「円盤でも落っこって来たか？」
dialogues.en: "Is a discus going to fall from it?"
dialogues.text: "Is a discus going to fall from it?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「まさか、そんなことは」
dialogues.en: "Haha, that couldn't happen."
dialogues.text: "Haha, that couldn't happen."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「じゃ、時期はずれのカブトムシでもいたか？」
dialogues.en: "Then, an out-of-season beetle?"
dialogues.text: "Then, an out-of-season beetle?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「いえ、いませんよ」
dialogues.en: "No, not at all."
dialogues.text: "No, not at all."

dialogues.jp: 環は口元に手を当てて笑う。
dialogues.en: She covered her mouth with her hand, stifling her giggling.
dialogues.text: She covered her mouth with her hand, stifling her giggling.

dialogues.jp: 「何かこの木に思い入れでもあるのか？」
dialogues.en: "Well, then what are you contemplating about this tree?"
dialogues.text: "Well, then what are you contemplating about this tree?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「いえ、そういう訳ではないのですが、あまり
　にも綺麗なものですから……」
dialogues.en:
"No, it's nothing like that. I was just admiring how
majestic and beautiful it is..."
dialogues.text:
"No, it's nothing like that. I was just admiring how
majestic and beautiful it is..."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「ま、引っ越して来た人間から見れば、そうか
　もしれないな」
dialogues.en: "Heh, people who just moved here all say similar things."
dialogues.text: "Heh, people who just moved here all say similar things."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「ええ。一年中桜が咲いているなんて、本当に
　素敵ですね」
dialogues.en:
"Yes. Seeing sakura petals that bloom all year long, is
wonderful."
dialogues.text:
"Yes. Seeing sakura petals that bloom all year long, is
wonderful."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「まあ、散り急ぐ｛はかな／儚｝さがいいって言う意見も、
　その通りだとは思うのですが」
dialogues.en:
"Although, I can see why other people might think
otherwise."
dialogues.text:
"Although, I can see why other people might think
otherwise."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「でも、いつ見ても桜は神秘的です」
dialogues.en: "But to me, sakura petals display a mysterious quality."
dialogues.text: "But to me, sakura petals display a mysterious quality."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「そうだな。俺なんか、見慣れてるからあまり
　何も感じないけど」
dialogues.en: "Hrm... for me, I can't feel anything special about them."
dialogues.text: "Hrm... for me, I can't feel anything special about them."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「この島に来て、もう２週間経ちますが、未だ
　に新しい発見があって、楽しいですよ」
dialogues.en:
"Although I have already been here two weeks, I'm happy to
still be constantly discovering new things."
dialogues.text:
"Although I have already been here two weeks, I'm happy to
still be constantly discovering new things."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「ふーん」
dialogues.en: "Mmm."
dialogues.text: "Mmm."

dialogues.jp: まあ、そんなもんなのかも知れないな。
dialogues.en: That's good for her.
dialogues.text: That's good for her.

dialogues.jp: 「だったら少し、散歩でもするか」
dialogues.en: "In that case, let's keep walking a little longer."
dialogues.text: "In that case, let's keep walking a little longer."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「本当ですか？」
dialogues.en: "Really?"
dialogues.text: "Really?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「うん。環が多分、まだ知らないところへ連れ
　て行ってやるよ」
dialogues.en: "Yeah. I believe I know of a place you haven't seen, yet."
dialogues.text: "Yeah. I believe I know of a place you haven't seen, yet."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「はい。ぜひ教えてください」
dialogues.en: "Please show it to me."
dialogues.text: "Please show it to me."

dialogues.jp: 環は満面の笑みを浮かべて俺について来る。
dialogues.en:
With her smile showing on her whole face, she followed after
me.
dialogues.text:
With her smile showing on her whole face, she followed after
me.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「うわ〜！　綺麗ですね」
dialogues.en: "Wow! So pretty!"
dialogues.text: "Wow! So pretty!"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「だろ」
dialogues.en: "Ain't it?"
dialogues.text: "Ain't it?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「こんな素敵なところがあるなんて。やっぱり
　初音島っていいところですよね」
dialogues.en:
"With such wonderful places like this... Hatsu-nejima is
indeed a splendid place to live in."
dialogues.text:
"With such wonderful places like this... Hatsu-nejima is
indeed a splendid place to live in."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「まあな」
dialogues.en: "Heh, I suppose."
dialogues.text: "Heh, I suppose."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「波がキラキラしてますよ」
dialogues.en: "The waves are glittering..."
dialogues.text: "The waves are glittering..."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「春の海って、綺麗ですね。音楽になるのも分
　かる気がします」
dialogues.en:
"The spring sea is very pretty too. Music would go perfectly
with it."
dialogues.text:
"The spring sea is very pretty too. Music would go perfectly
with it."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「音楽？」
dialogues.en: "Music?"
dialogues.text: "Music?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「ほら、あの琴の音色の……」
dialogues.en: "Yes, such as the strains of a koto..."
dialogues.text: "Yes, such as the strains of a koto..."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「あ、あのお正月によくかかるヤツな」
dialogues.en: "Ah, that instrument women always play on New Year's Day."
dialogues.text: "Ah, that instrument women always play on New Year's Day."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「そうそう。ああ、風が気持ちいい」
dialogues.en: "Yes, yes. Ahh, the wind feels good too!"
dialogues.text: "Yes, yes. Ahh, the wind feels good too!"

dialogues.jp: 環は長い髪をなびかせながら、一人つぶやく。
dialogues.en:
She blabbered to herself, the wind blowing through her long
hair.
dialogues.text:
She blabbered to herself, the wind blowing through her long
hair.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「私、海が大好きなんです」
dialogues.en: "I really like the sea."
dialogues.text: "I really like the sea."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「へえ。そうなんだ」
dialogues.en: "Heh, really?"
dialogues.text: "Heh, really?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「昔、海で溺れかけたことがあるのですが、不
　思議と怖くなかったんです」
dialogues.en:
"I had almost drowned in the sea during my childhood, but
strangely, I hold no fears of it."
dialogues.text:
"I had almost drowned in the sea during my childhood, but
strangely, I hold no fears of it."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「大きなものに抱かれているような気がして、
　むしろ安心できたんですよ」
dialogues.en:
"Being surrounded by at all sides by water makes me feel
more relaxed."
dialogues.text:
"Being surrounded by at all sides by water makes me feel
more relaxed."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「それから、海は大好きなんです」
dialogues.en: "Since then, I've always loved the sea."
dialogues.text: "Since then, I've always loved the sea."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「なるほどねぇ。まあ、俺も好きだけどさ」
dialogues.en: "Ahh. Well, I guess I like it too."
dialogues.text: "Ahh. Well, I guess I like it too."

dialogues.jp:
そういう体験をすると、普通、人は怖くなって
海を避けたりするもんだけどな。
dialogues.en:
You'd think someone with that kind of personal traumatic
experience would try to avoid the cause...
dialogues.text:
You'd think someone with that kind of personal traumatic
experience would try to avoid the cause...

dialogues.jp:
やっぱり、巫女は自然に守られてるのだろう
か？
dialogues.en: Maybe Miko really are given divine protection?
dialogues.text: Maybe Miko really are given divine protection?

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉様は、どうして海が好きなんですか？」
dialogues.en: "Why would you like the sea, Asakura-sama?"
dialogues.text: "Why would you like the sea, Asakura-sama?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「うーん。別に理由はないけど……。ま、波の
　音を聞くと、安心できるってぐらいかな」
dialogues.en:
"Well, I don't really have a reason like yours... the sound
of the waves do calm me down, though."
dialogues.text:
"Well, I don't really have a reason like yours... the sound
of the waves do calm me down, though."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「そうですか」
dialogues.en: "I see."
dialogues.text: "I see."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「みんなで海水浴に行くのもいいが、ただ見つ
　めるだけってのも、意外にいいよな」
dialogues.en:
"And looking at the sea makes me think of all the fun times
I've had, playing with others there."
dialogues.text:
"And looking at the sea makes me think of all the fun times
I've had, playing with others there."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「ええ。私、今日はとっても幸せな気持ちです」
dialogues.en: "Yes. I feel that I am truly lucky today."
dialogues.text: "Yes. I feel that I am truly lucky today."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.en: "Eh?"
dialogues.text: "Eh?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「いつもは、まっすぐ神社に帰るけど、たまに
　寄り道したら、朝倉様に出会えて……。こん
　な素敵な場所を教えてもらえたんですもの」
dialogues.en:
"From fortuitously meeting you today, and learning of such a
wonderful place..."
dialogues.text:
"From fortuitously meeting you today, and learning of such a
wonderful place..."

dialogues.jp: 環はにっこりと俺を見つめて微笑む。
dialogues.en: She turned to me, with the brightest of smiles on her face.
dialogues.text: She turned to me, with the brightest of smiles on her face.

dialogues.jp: 「大げさやな」
dialogues.en: "Haha, you're too much sometimes."
dialogues.text: "Haha, you're too much sometimes."

dialogues.jp: 俺は照れ隠しに、大きく伸びをする。
dialogues.en:
I tried to mask my embarassment with my words, and a big
yawn.
dialogues.text:
I tried to mask my embarassment with my words, and a big
yawn.

dialogues.jp: 穏やかに空気が流れる。
dialogues.en: The calm atmosphere continued on.
dialogues.text: The calm atmosphere continued on.

dialogues.jp: うららかな春の日差しを浴びて。
dialogues.en: We bathed in the sun of another glorious spring day.
dialogues.text: We bathed in the sun of another glorious spring day.

dialogues.jp:
こんな取りとめのない会話をしていても、心が
自然と和む。
dialogues.en:
Engaging in light conversation on this kind of day, made a
warm feeling course through my body.
dialogues.text:
Engaging in light conversation on this kind of day, made a
warm feeling course through my body.

dialogues.jp: ささやかな幸せ。
dialogues.en: One of nature's little blessings...
dialogues.text: One of nature's little blessings...

dialogues.jp: 多分、こういう時間を言うのだろう。
dialogues.en: That'd be what a time like this is called, for certain.
dialogues.text: That'd be what a time like this is called, for certain.

dialogues.jp: これって、
dialogues.en: Hrm... isn't this...
dialogues.text: Hrm... isn't this...

dialogues.jp: 見方を変えると、そのまんまデート？
dialogues.en: If you look at it another way, you could call this a date...
dialogues.text: If you look at it another way, you could call this a date...

dialogues.jp:
そう呼んでもおかしくないほど、今の空気は和
んでいる。
dialogues.en:
That doesn't sound bad though. It fits well with the
atmosphere.
dialogues.text:
That doesn't sound bad though. It fits well with the
atmosphere.

dialogues.jp: こんな散歩なら、いつでも大歓迎だ。
dialogues.en: I warmly welcomed the name, as we walked together.
dialogues.text: I warmly welcomed the name, as we walked together.

dialogues.jp: ◆海を見ていた◆
dialogues.en: ◆Watching The Sea?◆
dialogues.text: ◆Watching The Sea?◆

dialogues.jp:
帰り道、桜公園に立ち寄ると、環が桜の木を見
つめていた。
dialogues.en:
Dropping by the Sakura Park on the way home, I found Tamaki
staring at a Sakura tree.
dialogues.text:
Dropping by the Sakura Park on the way home, I found Tamaki
staring at a Sakura tree.

dialogues.jp:
二人で散歩しながら高台に行くと、環はとても
うれしそうに、海を見つめている。
dialogues.en:
We walked to higher ground, and Tamaki enjoyed the view of
the sea.
dialogues.text:
We walked to higher ground, and Tamaki enjoyed the view of
the sea.

dialogues.jp: これって、見方をかえればデートだよな。
dialogues.en: Anyone from the outside would've thought we were on a date.
dialogues.text: Anyone from the outside would've thought we were on a date.
